definitions.explanation: A form of government in which one person or a small group holds absolute power. Also used more broadly to describe any situation where one person has complete control.

examples.japanese: {独裁|どくさい}{政権|せいけん}は{人権|じんけん}を{侵害|しんがい}することが{多|おお}い。
{独裁者|どくさいしゃ}が{国|くに}を{支配|しはい}している。
{会社|かいしゃ}では{社長|しゃちょう}が{独裁的|どくさいてき}に{決定|けってい}を{下|くだ}す。
examples.english: At the company, the president makes decisions autocratically.

notes:
RELATED TERMS:
- {独裁者|どくさいしゃ}: dictator
- {独裁政権|どくさいせいけん}: dictatorship; autocratic regime
- {独裁的|どくさいてき}: dictatorial; autocratic
- {独裁国家|どくさいこっか}: dictatorial state

OPPOSITES:
- {民主主義|みんしゅしゅぎ}: democracy
- {民主|みんしゅ}: democratic

USAGE:
Used in political contexts but also metaphorically for:
- Workplace: ワンマン{経営|けいえい} (one-man management)
- Family: {家族|かぞく}{内|ない}での{独裁|どくさい}
- Organizations: {組織|そしき}{内|ない}の{独裁|どくさい}{体制|たいせい}

HISTORICAL:
Often discussed in relation to 20th century history (fascism, totalitarianism).
